caveats.en: Ships a win-cuda-13.5-arm64 build alongside cpu, vulkan and OpenCL (Adreno) arm64 builds. A performance regression on arm64 and Blackwell was tracked upstream and was not re-checked.
caveats.zh-TW: 提供 win-cuda-13.5-arm64 版本，另有 cpu、vulkan 與 OpenCL（Adreno）arm64 版本。上游曾追蹤 arm64 與 Blackwell 的效能回歸問題，本次未重新確認。
